findings.desc: Pipeline sequences reviewer lanes before verification evidence generation/refresh while assigning coverage verification to validate and the coverage reviewer. Evidence: plan lines around Step Contract Matrix rows for reviewer/evidence and End-To-End Flow show reviewer batch before evidence generation. This can let test-coverage review pass before final material-bound evidence exists, or require an unstated second review loop. Fix by moving evidence generation/refresh before reviewer batch, or explicitly split lanes so coverage/delivery review runs only after final evidence is material-bound.

SVG compresses smoke/transcript/delivery context and jumps toward done_prepare PASS without an explicit delivery-review or delivery-check decision. Markdown preserves the gate, so this is advisory, but the image should show delivery reviewer pass/fail to avoid implying a weaker DONE path.

Metadata-only waiver policy is left open. The plan says transcript/user-value proof may be waived for explicit metadata-only stories, but Track E/F implementers still need a concrete command, schema, and owner before implementing fail-closed behavior. Advisory for current execution-plan doc.

Rendered SVG has visual ambiguity/overlap around PLAN skeleton and DEV implementation boxes. Markdown text flow and Mermaid source remain readable, so this does not block implementation, but the image should be cleaned up for a strict execution-plan artifact.

CHK-002 edge evidence only runs xmllint --noout for the SVG. That proves XML validity but not the intent that the SVG visually distinguishes ordinary preflight from TEST-to-DONE done_prepare delegation. The SVG contains relevant nodes, but the recorded evidence command does not assert them, so semantic coverage for CHK-002 edge is missing.

Several recorded rg evidence commands are not cleanly replayable because Markdown backticks inside double-quoted shell patterns can trigger command substitution in zsh, producing command-not-found stderr while rg still exits 0. Gate evidence should be deterministic and stderr-clean; replace affected evidence commands with single-quoted patterns or split rg checks that avoid backtick substitution.
